registration_note: The commit that adds this file is the registration. No series named below was read for these dates before it; where a series already sits in a repository file, the exposure field says so.
scope: every catalog chain with a measured or timed link in docs/results/chain_check_v1.json (run Oct 5, 2026), except the 2022 chatbot launch chain, which the project's naming rule keeps out of pushed files

tools.ssa_repo: chain_check.ssa_test on the chain's own counts
tools.wiki_seasonal: chain_check.wiki_test at the date and at the same date one and two years earlier
tools.wiki_persist_peak / wiki_persist_ratio: means of daily views (user agent, all-access) over registered windows

network: honest user agent, at least 1 second between requests, stop on 403, 429 or 5xx with no same-day retry
